fix: Correct database schema mapping in dashboard

Fixed database field mapping issues in the trade dashboard. The actual
database schema uses different column names than initially assumed.

Schema corrections:
- profit → result (actual profit/loss value)
- type → status (trade status field)
- open_price → entry_price
- close_price → removed (not used in schema)
- sl → sl_price
- tp → tp_price

Changes:
1. src/web/dashboard.py:
   - Updated /api/stats to use result instead of profit
   - Updated /api/trades to select correct columns
   - Updated /api/performance to use result and status instead of type
   - Updated /api/equity-curve for new field names
   - Added NULL checks for optional fields

2. src/web/templates/dashboard.html:
   - Updated trade table to show actual database columns
   - Fixed field mapping in JavaScript (entry_price, sl_price, tp_price, result)
   - Updated column headers to match actual data
   - Added status badge instead of type badge
   - Added NULL check for timestamps

Result:
- All API endpoints now return 200 OK
- Dashboard correctly displays 3 trades from database
- Stats, charts, and table all working properly
- No more 500 errors on API calls
